name_list =: 3 : 0
    if. (,y)-:,'-' do.
        0$a:
    else.
        split_commas y
    end.
)
point_requirements =: 3 : 0
    result =. 0 2$0
    for_item. name_list y do.
        item =. >item
        colon =. item i.':'
        point =. PointNames i.<colon{.item
        position =. 'R'={:item
        result =. result,point,position
    end.
    result
)
read_routes =: 3 : 0
    lines =. read_lines 'input/routes.txt'
    RouteNames =: 0$a:
    for_line. lines do.
        RouteNames =: RouteNames,1{split_words >line
    end.
    RouteStarts =: i.0
    RouteFinishNames =: 0$a:
    RouteFinishKinds =: i.0
    RouteFinishes =: i.0
    RouteRequirements =: 0$a:
    RouteSections =: 0$a:
    RouteOverlap =: 0$a:
    RouteConflicts =: 0$a:
    RouteApproachTimes =: i.0
    for_line. lines do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        start =. SignalNames i.2{fields
        finish =. 3{::fields
        RouteStarts =: RouteStarts,start
        RouteFinishNames =: RouteFinishNames,<finish
        if. (<finish)e.SignalNames do.
            kind =. 0
            index =. SignalNames i.<finish
        elseif. (<finish)e.BufferNames do.
            kind =. 1
            index =. BufferNames i.<finish
        else.
            kind =. 2
            index =. BoundaryNames i.<finish
        end.
        RouteFinishKinds =: RouteFinishKinds,kind
        RouteFinishes =: RouteFinishes,index
        requirements =. (point_requirements 4{::fields),point_requirements 7{::fields
        RouteRequirements =: RouteRequirements,<requirements
        RouteSections =: RouteSections,<SectionNames i.name_list 5{::fields
        RouteOverlap =: RouteOverlap,<SectionNames i.name_list 6{::fields
        RouteConflicts =: RouteConflicts,<RouteNames i.name_list 8{::fields
        RouteApproachTimes =: RouteApproachTimes,".9{::fields
    end.
    count =. #RouteNames
    RouteDirections =: RouteStarts{SignalDirections
    RouteStates =: count$0
    RouteReleaseTimes =: count$_1
    RoutePassed =: (count,#SectionNames)$0
    RouteOverlapLocked =: count$0
    RouteOverlapCounters =: count$0
    RouteStats =: (count,7)$0
    SectionRouteLocks =: (#SectionNames)$_1
    SectionOverlapLocks =: ((#SectionNames),count)$0
    PointLocks =: (#PointNames)$<0 2$0
)
lock_route =: 3 : 0
    RouteStates =: 1 y}RouteStates
    RouteReleaseTimes =: _1 y}RouteReleaseTimes
    RoutePassed =: ((#SectionNames)$0)y}RoutePassed
    RouteOverlapLocked =: 1 y}RouteOverlapLocked
    RouteOverlapCounters =: 0 y}RouteOverlapCounters
    SectionRouteLocks =: y(y{::RouteSections)}SectionRouteLocks
    for_section. y{::RouteOverlap do.
        SectionOverlapLocks =: 1(<section,y)}SectionOverlapLocks
    end.
    for_requirement. y{::RouteRequirements do.
        'point position' =. requirement
        locks =. ~.(point{::PointLocks),y,position
        PointLocks =: (<locks)point}PointLocks
    end.
)
unlock_points =: 4 : 0
    for_point. i.#PointNames do.
        if. (0=#y)+.(point{PointCommon)e.y do.
            locks =. point{::PointLocks
            locks =. locks#~x~:0{"1 locks
            PointLocks =: (<locks)point}PointLocks
        end.
    end.
)
unlock_section =: 4 : 0
    if. x=y{SectionRouteLocks do.
        SectionRouteLocks =: _1 y}SectionRouteLocks
    end.
    x unlock_points ,y
)
unlock_overlap =: 3 : 0
    for_section. y{::RouteOverlap do.
        SectionOverlapLocks =: 0(<section,y)}SectionOverlapLocks
    end.
    sections =. y{::RouteOverlap
    if. #sections do.
        y unlock_points sections
    end.
    RouteOverlapLocked =: 0 y}RouteOverlapLocked
)
release_route =: 3 : 0
    for_section. y{::RouteSections do.
        if. y=section{SectionRouteLocks do.
            SectionRouteLocks =: _1 section}SectionRouteLocks
        end.
    end.
    if. y{RouteOverlapLocked do.
        unlock_overlap y
    end.
    y unlock_points i.0
    RouteStates =: 0 y}RouteStates
    RouteReleaseTimes =: _1 y}RouteReleaseTimes
)

read_layout =: 3 : 0
    lines =. read_lines 'input/layout.txt'
    SectionNames =: 0$a:
    SectionLengths =: i.0
    SectionRows =: i.0
    SectionFirst =: i.0
    SectionLast =: i.0
    for_line. lines do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        if. 'SECTION'-:0{::fields do.
            SectionNames =: SectionNames,1{fields
            'length row first last' =. ".' 'join 2}.fields
            SectionLengths =: SectionLengths,length
            SectionRows =: SectionRows,row
            SectionFirst =: SectionFirst,first
            SectionLast =: SectionLast,last
        end.
    end.
    count =. #SectionNames
    EndKinds =: (count,2)$_1
    EndValues =: (count,2)$_1
    SignalAt =: (count,2)$_1
    SectionFailed =: count$0
    Occupants =: count$<i.0
    SectionOccupiedSeconds =: count$0
    SectionLockedSeconds =: count$0
    SectionTrains =: count$<i.0
    PointNames =: 0$a:
    PointSide =: i.0
    PointCommon =: i.0
    PointNormal =: i.0
    PointReverse =: i.0
    PointRows =: i.0
    PointColumns =: i.0
    SignalNames =: 0$a:
    SignalSections =: i.0
    SignalDirections =: i.0
    SignalRows =: i.0
    SignalColumns =: i.0
    BufferNames =: 0$a:
    BufferSections =: i.0
    BufferEnds =: i.0
    BufferRows =: i.0
    BufferColumns =: i.0
    BoundaryNames =: 0$a:
    BoundarySections =: i.0
    BoundaryEnds =: i.0
    Labels =: 0$a:
    for_line. lines do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        kind =. 0{::fields
        select. kind
        case. 'JOINT' do.
            first =. SectionNames i.1{fields
            second =. SectionNames i.2{fields
            EndKinds =: 0(<first,1)}EndKinds
            EndKinds =: 0(<second,0)}EndKinds
            EndValues =: second(<first,1)}EndValues
            EndValues =: first(<second,0)}EndValues
        case. 'POINT' do.
            point =. #PointNames
            PointNames =: PointNames,1{fields
            side =. 'R'={.2{::fields
            common =. SectionNames i.3{fields
            normal =. SectionNames i.4{fields
            reverse =. SectionNames i.5{fields
            PointSide =: PointSide,side
            PointCommon =: PointCommon,common
            PointNormal =: PointNormal,normal
            PointReverse =: PointReverse,reverse
            PointRows =: PointRows,".6{::fields
            PointColumns =: PointColumns,".7{::fields
            EndKinds =: 1(<common,side)}EndKinds
            EndValues =: point(<common,side)}EndValues
            for_section. normal,reverse do.
                position =. <section,1-side
                EndKinds =: 1 position}EndKinds
                EndValues =: point position}EndValues
            end.
        case. 'SIGNAL' do.
            signal =. #SignalNames
            SignalNames =: SignalNames,1{fields
            section =. SectionNames i.2{fields
            direction =. 'DOWN'-:3{::fields
            SignalSections =: SignalSections,section
            SignalDirections =: SignalDirections,direction
            SignalRows =: SignalRows,".4{::fields
            SignalColumns =: SignalColumns,".5{::fields
            SignalAt =: signal(<section,direction)}SignalAt
        case. 'BUFFER';'BOUNDARY' do.
            section =. SectionNames i.2{fields
            side =. 'R'={.3{::fields
            position =. <section,side
            if. kind-:'BUFFER' do.
                index =. #BufferNames
                BufferNames =: BufferNames,1{fields
                BufferSections =: BufferSections,section
                BufferEnds =: BufferEnds,side
                BufferRows =: BufferRows,".4{::fields
                BufferColumns =: BufferColumns,".5{::fields
                EndKinds =: 2 position}EndKinds
            else.
                index =. #BoundaryNames
                BoundaryNames =: BoundaryNames,1{fields
                BoundarySections =: BoundarySections,section
                BoundaryEnds =: BoundaryEnds,side
                EndKinds =: 3 position}EndKinds
            end.
            EndValues =: index position}EndValues
        case. 'LABEL' do.
            Labels =: Labels,<(<".1{::fields),(<".2{::fields),3{fields
        end.
    end.
    count =. #PointNames
    PointPositions =: count$0
    PointMoving =: count$0
    PointFailed =: count$0
    PointTargets =: count$_1
    PointCompletions =: count$_1
    PointThrows =: count$0
    PointLockedSeconds =: count$0
    PointMovingSeconds =: count$0
    SignalAspects =: (#SignalNames)$0
    SignalSeconds =: ((#SignalNames),3)$0
    SignalPasses =: (#SignalNames)$0
    rows =. SectionRows,PointRows,SignalRows,BufferRows
    columns =. SectionLast,PointColumns,SignalColumns,BufferColumns
    for_label. Labels do.
        'row column text' =. >label
        rows =. rows,row
        columns =. columns,(column+#text)-1
    end.
    DiagramHeight =: 1+>./rows
    DiagramWidth =: 1+>./columns
)
point_detected =: 3 : '-.(y{PointMoving)+.y{PointFailed'
beyond =: 4 : 0
    position =. <x,1-y
    kind =. position{EndKinds
    value =. position{EndValues
    if. kind~:1 do.
        kind,value return.
    end.
    point =. value
    branch =. point{PointNormal
    if. point{PointPositions do.
        branch =. point{PointReverse
    end.
    if. (point{PointMoving)+.((x~:point{PointCommon)*.x~:branch) do.
        4 _1
    elseif. x=point{PointCommon do.
        0,branch
    else.
        0,point{PointCommon
    end.
)

load 'layout.ijs'
load 'interlocking.ijs'
load 'signals.ijs'
load 'trains.ijs'
load 'safety.ijs'

AspectNames =: ;:'RED YELLOW GREEN'
StateNames =: ;:'WAITING RUNNING EXITED'
RouteStateNames =: (<'none'),;:'LOCKED USED APPROACH'
DirectionNames =: ;:'UP DOWN'
intdiv =: 4 : '<.(x:x)%x:y'
integer =: 3 : 0
    text =. ,":y
    '-'(I.text='_')}text
)
join =: 4 : 0
    result =. ''
    for_i. i.#y do.
        if. i do.
            result =. result,x
        end.
        result =. result,i{::y
    end.
    result
)
read_lines =: 3 : 0
    text =. 1!:1 <y
    if. 0=#text do.
        0$a:
    else.
        <;._2 text
    end.
)
split_words =: 3 : '<;._1 '' '',y'
split_commas =: 3 : '<;._1 '','',y'
log_event =: 3 : 'EventLog =: EventLog,<(integer Time),'' '',y'

read_settings =: 3 : 0
    for_line. read_lines 'input/params.txt' do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        values =. ".' 'join }.fields
        select. 0{::fields
        case. 'END' do. EndTime =: {.values
        case. 'THROW' do. ThrowTime =: {.values
        case. 'OVERLAP' do. OverlapTime =: {.values
        case. 'SNAPSHOTS' do. SnapshotTimes =: ,values
        end.
    end.
    Events =: 0$a:
    for_line. read_lines 'input/events.txt' do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        Events =: Events,<(<".0{::fields),(1{fields),<2}.fields
    end.
    Time =: 0
    QRoutes =: i.0
    QTimes =: i.0
    QReasons =: 0$a:
    QActive =: i.0

    Snapshots =: 0$a:

)
start_throw =: 4 : 0
    PointMoving =: 1 x}PointMoving
    PointTargets =: y x}PointTargets
    completion =. Time+ThrowTime
    PointCompletions =: completion x}PointCompletions
    log_event 'MOVE ',(x{::PointNames),' ',(y{'NR'),' until ',integer completion
)
complete_throws =: 3 : 0
    for_point. I.PointMoving*.PointCompletions=Time do.
        position =. point{PointTargets
        PointPositions =: position point}PointPositions
        PointMoving =: 0 point}PointMoving
        PointCompletions =: _1 point}PointCompletions
        PointThrows =: ((point{PointThrows)+1)point}PointThrows
        log_event 'POINT ',(point{::PointNames),' ',position{'NR'
    end.
)
release_approaches =: 3 : 0
    for_route. I.(RouteStates=3)*.RouteReleaseTimes=Time do.
        release_route route
        log_event 'TIMEOUT ',route{::RouteNames
    end.
)
add_request =: 4 : 0
    number =. 1+#QRoutes
    QRoutes =: QRoutes,x
    QTimes =: QTimes,Time
    QReasons =: QReasons,<''
    QActive =: QActive,1
    x route_stat_add 0 1
    log_event 'REQUEST q',(integer number),' ',(x{::RouteNames),' ',y
)
cancel_route =: 3 : 0
    pending =. I.QActive*.QRoutes=y
    if. #pending do.
        for_request. pending do.
            log_event 'DROP q',(integer request+1),' ',y{::RouteNames
            QActive =: 0 request}QActive
            Dropped =: Dropped+1
        end.
        i.0 return.
    end.
    state =. y{RouteStates
    if. state=1 do.
        y route_stat_add 3 1
        signal =. y{RouteStarts
        if. (0~:signal{SignalAspects)*.occupied signal{SignalSections do.
            release =. Time+y{RouteApproachTimes
            RouteStates =: 3 y}RouteStates
            RouteReleaseTimes =: release y}RouteReleaseTimes
            log_event 'CANCEL ',(y{::RouteNames),' approach until ',integer release
        else.
            release_route y
            log_event 'CANCEL ',(y{::RouteNames),' released'
        end.
    else.
        detail =. 'refused'
        if. state=0 do.
            detail =. 'none'
        end.
        log_event 'CANCEL ',(y{::RouteNames),' ',detail
    end.
)
individual_throw =: 4 : 0
    if. #x{::PointLocks do.
        result =. 'locked'
    elseif. x{PointFailed do.
        result =. 'failed'
    elseif. x{PointMoving do.
        result =. 'moving'
    elseif. occupied x{PointCommon do.
        result =. 'occupied'
    elseif. y=x{PointPositions do.
        result =. 'none'
    else.
        result =. 'start'
    end.
    log_event 'THROW ',(x{::PointNames),' ',(y{'NR'),' ',result
    if. result-:'start' do.
        x start_throw y
    end.
)
execute_events =: 3 : 0
    for_event. Events do.
        'time command arguments' =. >event
        if. time~:Time do.
            continue.
        end.
        name =. 0{::arguments
        select. command
        case. 'REQUEST' do.
            (RouteNames i.<name)add_request 'OPERATOR'
        case. 'CANCEL' do.
            cancel_route RouteNames i.<name
        case. 'THROW' do.
            point =. PointNames i.<name
            point individual_throw 'R'={.1{::arguments
        case. 'TCFAIL';'TCFIX' do.
            section =. SectionNames i.<name
            SectionFailed =: (command-:'TCFAIL')section}SectionFailed
            log_event command,' ',name
        case. 'POINTFAIL';'POINTFIX' do.
            point =. PointNames i.<name
            failed =. command-:'POINTFAIL'
            PointFailed =: failed point}PointFailed
            if. failed*.point{PointMoving do.
                PointCompletions =: _1 point}PointCompletions
            end.
            log_event command,' ',name
            if. (-.failed)*.point{PointMoving do.
                point start_throw point{PointTargets
            end.
        end.
    end.
)
opposite_lock =: 4 : 0
    +./(y{RouteDirections)~:x{RouteDirections
)
request_reason =: 3 : 0
    route =. y
    if. route{RouteStates do.
        'busy' return.
    end.
    for_other. route{::RouteConflicts do.
        if. (other{RouteStates)e.1 3 do.
            'conflict ',other{::RouteNames return.
        end.
    end.
    for_section. route{::RouteSections do.
        if. occupied section do.
            'occupied ',section{::SectionNames return.
        end.
        overlaps =. I.section{SectionOverlapLocks
        if. (_1~:section{SectionRouteLocks)+.(overlaps opposite_lock route) do.
            'locked ',section{::SectionNames return.
        end.
    end.
    for_section. route{::RouteOverlap do.
        if. occupied section do.
            'occupied ',section{::SectionNames return.
        end.
        locks =. I.section{SectionOverlapLocks
        owner =. section{SectionRouteLocks
        if. owner~:_1 do.
            locks =. locks,owner
        end.
        if. locks opposite_lock route do.
            'locked ',section{::SectionNames return.
        end.
    end.
    for_requirement. route{::RouteRequirements do.
        'point position' =. requirement
        locks =. point{::PointLocks
        if. +./position~:1{"1 locks do.
            'point ',(point{::PointNames),' locked' return.
        end.
        if. ((-.point{PointMoving)*.position=point{PointPositions)+.((point{PointMoving)*.position=point{PointTargets) do.
            continue.
        end.
        if. point{PointFailed do.
            'point ',(point{::PointNames),' failed' return.
        elseif. point{PointMoving do.
            'point ',(point{::PointNames),' moving' return.
        elseif. occupied point{PointCommon do.
            'point ',(point{::PointNames),' occupied' return.
        end.
    end.
    ''
)
judge_requests =: 3 : 0
    for_request. I.QActive do.
        route =. request{QRoutes
        reason =. request_reason route
        if. #reason do.
            if. -.reason-:request{::QReasons do.
                log_event 'WAIT q',(integer request+1),' ',(route{::RouteNames),' ',reason
                QReasons =: (<reason)request}QReasons
            end.
            continue.
        end.
        QActive =: 0 request}QActive
        lock_route route
        wait =. Time-request{QTimes
        log_event 'GRANT q',(integer request+1),' ',(route{::RouteNames),' wait ',integer wait
        route route_stat_add 1 1
        route route_stat_add 4,wait
        position =. <route,5
        RouteStats =: (wait>.position{RouteStats)position}RouteStats
        for_requirement. route{::RouteRequirements do.
            'point target' =. requirement
            if. (-.point{PointMoving)*.target~:point{PointPositions do.
                point start_throw target
            end.
        end.
    end.
)
decide_signals =: 3 : 0
    decided =. decide_aspects ''
    for_signal. I.decided~:SignalAspects do.
        log_event 'SIGNAL ',(signal{::SignalNames),' ',(signal{decided){::AspectNames
    end.
    SignalAspects =: decided
)

occupied_parts =: 3 : 0
    result =. 0 4$0
    if. 1~:y{TrainStates do.
        result return.
    end.
    head =. y{TrainHeads
    tail =. head-y{TrainLengths
    for_part. y{::TrainPaths do.
        'section start' =. part
        end =. start+section{SectionLengths
        if. (start<head)*.end>tail do.
            result =. result,section,start,(tail>.start),head<.end
        end.
    end.
    result
)
head_section =: 3 : 0
    path =. y{::TrainPaths
    head =. y{TrainHeads
    for_i. |.i.#path do.
        part =. i{path
        if. (1{part)<head do.
            part return.
        end.
    end.
    0{path
)
enter_train =: 3 : 0
    state =. y{TrainStates
    if. state=2 do.
        0 return.
    elseif. state=1 do.
        1 return.
    end.
    boundary =. y{TrainEntry
    section =. boundary{BoundarySections
    if. (Time<y{TrainEntryTimes)+.(occupied section)+.boundary{EnteredBoundaries do.
        0 return.
    end.
    TrainStates =: 1 y}TrainStates
    TrainDirections =: (boundary{BoundaryEnds)y}TrainDirections
    TrainPaths =: (<,:section,0)y}TrainPaths
    TrainHeads =: 0 y}TrainHeads
    TrainSpeeds =: (y{TrainEntrySpeed)y}TrainSpeeds
    TrainEntered =: Time y}TrainEntered
    EnteredBoundaries =: 1 boundary}EnteredBoundaries
    log_event 'ENTER ',(y{::TrainNames),' ',boundary{::BoundaryNames
    1
)
reverse_train =: 4 : 0
    'section start' =. head_section x
    end =. start+section{SectionLengths
    parts =. occupied_parts x
    path =. 0 2$0
    for_part. |.parts do.
        'section origin low high' =. part
        coordinate =. end-(origin+section{SectionLengths)
        path =. path,section,coordinate
    end.
    TrainPaths =: (<path)x}TrainPaths
    TrainHeads =: (end-((x{TrainHeads)-x{TrainLengths))x}TrainHeads
    TrainDirections =: (1-x{TrainDirections)x}TrainDirections
    log_event 'REVERSE ',(x{::TrainNames),' ',y{::SectionNames
)
finish_dwell =: 3 : 0
    if. -.y{TrainDwelling do.
        1 return.
    end.
    index =. y{TrainStopIndices
    stops =. y{::TrainStops
    stop =. index{stops
    if. (Time<(5{stop)+2{stop)+.Time<4{stop do.
        0 return.
    end.
    TrainDwelling =: 0 y}TrainDwelling
    TrainAwaitingDeparture =: index y}TrainAwaitingDeparture
    TrainStopIndices =: (index+1)y}TrainStopIndices
    if. 0{stop do.
        y reverse_train 1{stop
    end.
    1
)
limit_distance =: 3 : 0
    if. _1~:y{TrainBoundary do.
        _1 return.
    end.
    'section start' =. head_section y
    direction =. y{TrainDirections
    distance =. (start+section{SectionLengths)-y{TrainHeads
    index =. y{TrainStopIndices
    stops =. y{::TrainStops
    while. 1 do.
        signal =. (<section,direction){SignalAt
        if. signal~:_1 do.
            if. 0=signal{SignalAspects do.
                distance return.
            end.
        end.
        if. index<#stops do.
            if. section=(<index,1){stops do.
                distance return.
            end.
        end.
        'kind following' =. section beyond direction
        if. kind=3 do.
            _1 return.
        elseif. kind e.2 4 do.
            distance return.
        end.
        distance =. distance+following{SectionLengths
        section =. following
    end.
)
pass_signal =: 4 : 0
    routes =. I.(RouteStarts=y)*.RouteStates e.1 3
    route_name =. '-'
    if. #routes do.
        route =. {.routes
        route_name =. route{::RouteNames
    end.
    aspect =. y{SignalAspects
    log_event 'PASS ',(x{::TrainNames),' ',(y{::SignalNames),' ',(aspect{::AspectNames),' ',route_name
    SignalPasses =: ((y{SignalPasses)+1)y}SignalPasses
    TrainPasses =: ((x{TrainPasses)+1)x}TrainPasses
    if. #routes do.
        RouteStates =: 2 route}RouteStates
        route route_stat_add 2 1
    end.
    if. aspect=0 do.
        detail =. (x{::TrainNames),' ',y{::SignalNames
        log_event 'SPAD ',detail
        3 safety_check detail
        TrainEmergency =: 1 x}TrainEmergency
    else.
        3 safety_check ''
    end.
)
move_train =: 4 : 0
    train =. x
    remaining =. y
    'section start' =. head_section train
    while. remaining>0 do.
        head =. train{TrainHeads
        if. _1~:train{TrainBoundary do.
            TrainHeads =: (head+remaining)train}TrainHeads
            break.
        end.
        end =. start+section{SectionLengths
        if. (head+remaining)<:end do.
            TrainHeads =: (head+remaining)train}TrainHeads
            break.
        end.
        remaining =. remaining-(end-head)
        TrainHeads =: end train}TrainHeads
        signal =. (<section,train{TrainDirections){SignalAt
        if. signal~:_1 do.
            train pass_signal signal
        end.
        index =. train{TrainAwaitingDeparture
        if. index~:_1 do.
            stops =. train{::TrainStops
            if. section=(<index,1){stops do.
                log_event 'DEPART ',(train{::TrainNames),' ',section{::SectionNames
                stops =. Time(<index,6)}stops
                TrainStops =: (<stops)train}TrainStops
                TrainAwaitingDeparture =: _1 train}TrainAwaitingDeparture
